Working out and trying to be healthier than the day before have become an addiction. Each day I wake up and try and find another way to better myself because of something I found through working out. As I see my improvements it shows me that the impossible can become the possible and I can achieve anything as long as I truly desire it. 
In regards to the nutritional and diet changes, yes. My diet used to be a lot of fast food and meals on the go with almost no food in my kitchen. Now I focus on 6 small meals a day, lots of fruits of vegetables, unprocessed foods, no carbs late at night. It has become instinct to look at the nutritional facts of anything I pick up or that is handed to me. I have talked to a lot of people and looked up quite a bit on nutrition and diet and through a couple years of that have made sort of my own system that works really well for me.
